description: Returns the serial number of the date before or after a specified number of workdays with custom weekend parameters.

params.description: A serial date number that represents the start date.
params.name: arg1

params.description: The number of nonweekend and non-holiday days before or after the start date. A positive value for days yields a future date; a negative value yields a past date.
params.name: arg2

params.description: A number or string specifying when weekends occur.
params.name: arg3

params.description: An optional range or array of one or more serial date numbers to exclude from the working calendar, such as state and federal holidays and floating holidays.
params.name: arg4

signature: WORKDAY_INTL(arg1: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg2: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg3?: ApiRange | ApiName | number | string, arg4?: ApiRange | ApiName | number[]): number
